cases.name: waiting_ranked_by_wake
cases.description: Runs that wait on another Agent or an outside event are Waiting rows, counted In progress, and rank by the hub's next wake of them (work.wake_at) with the park and the usage limit: the soonest first, rows with no wake after them (a fallback check the hub dropped as long overdue, a named wait the hub schedules no wake for, an open PR), the longest waiting first. A moment's model failure the hub retries is Working.
